posts.author: XnoKiller
posts.body:
Hello, I installed RPG maker ace not long ago and I have a big problem, I created a project not a few days ago and now my maps are no longer in it and when I create them news I have an error:
script '(eval)' line 1:NoMethodError Occurred.
undefined method '[]=' for nil:NilClass
I have no idea how to fix it, please help me.

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body:
Check the events on the first map you visit, the starting map or the one where you ended the playtest a few days ago.
One of the events calls a script that tries to modify an array.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
you added a damaged script to the script engine, or a script for a wrong maker or something like that.
and the problematic script has the name (eval)
about your maps - that has nothing to do with scripts.
it can either be deleted files or a damaged mapinfo file.
if you go to your project in the explorer, are the mapfiles still there?

posts.author: kyonides
posts.body:
Andar said:

and the problematic script has the name (eval)
Click to expand...
Err, nope, it's a call script event that needs to be
eval
uated by the interpreter. That's why it doesn't mention anything like Script '' line 1 there.
